summary: Typemill is a flat-file content management system designed for authors and writers. It uses a visual markdown editor built with Vue.js to manage documentation and publications without requiring a traditional database.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams who want to write and publish content in markdown while storing everything directly on the file system.
watchOut: Because it relies on flat files rather than a database, managing very large content volumes or complex relational data can become cumbersome compared to heavier alternatives.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a standard web server such as Nginx or Apache with PHP support and persistent file storage for your content.
